name: Tunisia
regionName: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan
legislatureName: Assembly of People's Representatives (Majlis Nawwab ash-Sha'ab)

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: Current of Love (formerly the Popular Petition party)
Dignity Coalition or Al Karama Coalition
Movement of Socialist Democrats or MDS
Party of the Democratic Arab Vanguard

profile.languages: Arabic (official, one of the languages of commerce), French (commerce), Tamazight
profile.religions: Muslim (official; Sunni) 99%, other (includes Christian, Jewish, Shia Muslim, and Baha'i) <1%
profile.legalSystem: mixed system of civil law, based on the French civil code and Islamic (sharia) law; Supreme Court reviews some legislative acts in joint session
profile.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal except for active government security forces (including the police and the military), people with mental disabilities, people who have served more than three months in prison (criminal cases only), and people given a suspended sentence of more than six months
profile.nationalHoliday: Independence Day, 20 March (1956); Revolution and Youth Day, 14 January (2011)
profile.location: Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Algeria and Libya
